translation: Used on the kneecap, although it restrains, it does not cause pain. Explanation of use: The kneecap bone covers the ends of the thigh bone (楗) and shin bone (䯒); it is originally a movable thing. If it is injured, either the bone body is shattered, or it leaves its position and protrudes to the left or right. Although one pushes it back into its original position with the hand, when walking, stepping, stopping, and moving, it will certainly be pulled by that; therefore one uses the knee-embracing instrument to secure it, so that it does not leave its original position again and leave the affliction of a lame foot.
